## Summary Statistics

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r}

# Count number of repeated measurements per subject
library(dplyr)

counts <- crd %>%
  group_by(PID) %>%
  summarise(n_obs = n(), .groups = "drop")
  

hist(counts$n_obs,breaks=seq(0,14,by=1))
summary(counts$n_obs)

```

```{r}
cplot <- hetcor(crd1[,3:15], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")$correlations
corrplot(cplot)

corrplot(hetcor(crd[,3:15], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")$correlations)
```

## preliminary mixed effects fitting

```{r}
fit1 <- lme(EGFR_CRIC~SEX + RACE_CAT_1+AGE_INTEGER+
                  BMI+HEMOGLOBIN_A1C+HIBP+DAYS_THISVISIT+
                  DIABETES_AT_BASELINE,random = ~1|PID,data=crd)

summary(fit1)

crd$marginal_pred <- predict(fit1, level = 0)

# 2. Conditional predictions (includes subject intercepts)
crd$conditional_pred <- predict(fit1, level = 1)

# 3. Compare observed vs. marginal
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(crd, aes(x = DAYS_THISVISIT, y = EGFR_CRIC)) +
  stat_summary(aes(y = EGFR_CRIC, color = "Observed"),fun = mean, geom = "point", color = "black") + # observed means
  stat_summary(aes(y = marginal_pred, color="Marginal"), fun = mean, geom = "point", shape=15,color = "red") + # marginal
  stat_summary(aes(y = conditional_pred,color="Conditional"), fun = mean, geom = "point", shape=17,color = "blue") +
  labs(y = "EGFR", x = "Years", 
       title = "Observed vs Marginal vs Conditional Predictions",color="Prediction Type") 



fit2 <- lme(EGFR_CRIC~SEX + RACE_CAT_1+AGE_INTEGER+
                  BMI+HEMOGLOBIN_A1C+HIBP+DAYS_THISVISIT+
                  DIABETES_AT_BASELINE,random = ~1|PID,data=crd_filtered)

summary(fit2)

crd_filtered$marginal_pred <- predict(fit2, level = 0)

 
crd_filtered$conditional_pred <- predict(fit2, level = 1)



ggplot(crd_filtered, aes(x = DAYS_THISVISIT, y = EGFR_CRIC)) +
  stat_summary(aes(y = EGFR_CRIC, color = "Observed"),fun = mean, geom = "point", color = "black") + # observed means
  stat_summary(aes(y = marginal_pred, color="Marginal"), fun = mean, geom = "point", shape=15,color = "red") + # marginal
  stat_summary(aes(y = conditional_pred,color="Conditional"), fun = mean, geom = "point", shape=17,color = "blue") +
  labs(y = "EGFR", x = "Years", 
       title = "Observed vs Marginal vs Conditional Predictions",color="Prediction Type") 

```
```{r}
crd$AGE_z <- scale(crd$AGE_INTEGER);crd$BMI_z <- scale(crd$BMI)
# fit3 <- glmer(ANYCVD~AGE_z+BMI_z+HEMOGLOBIN_A1C+
#                DAYS_THISVISIT+(1|PID),data=crd,family=binomial())
# summary(fit3)

crd_filtered$AGE_z <- scale(crd_filtered$AGE_INTEGER);crd_filtered$BMI_z <- scale(crd_filtered$BMI)
fit4 <- glmer(ANYCVD~SEX + RACE_CAT_1+AGE_z+BMI_z+HEMOGLOBIN_A1C+HIBP + 
               DAYS_THISVISIT+(1|PID),data=crd_filtered ,family=binomial())
summary(fit4)
# Conditional predictions (subject-specific)
crd_filtered$pred_conditional <- predict(fit4, type = "response")  # includes random intercepts

# Marginal predictions (population-average, ignore random effects)
crd_filtered$pred_marginal <- predict(fit4, type = "response", re.form = NA) 


# Aggregate by DAYS_THISVISIT
summary_df <- crd_filtered %>%
  group_by(DAYS_THISVISIT) %>%
  summarise(
    obs_rate = mean(ANYCVD, na.rm = TRUE),
    marginal = mean(pred_marginal, na.rm = TRUE),
    conditional = mean(pred_conditional, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = DAYS_THISVISIT)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = obs_rate, color = "Observed"), size = 2) +
  geom_point(aes(y = marginal, color = "Marginal"), shape = 15) +
  geom_point(aes(y = conditional, color = "Conditional"), shape=17, size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Observed" = "black",
                                "Marginal" = "red",
                                "Conditional" = "blue")) +
  labs(y = "Probability of ANYCVD",
       x = "Years since baseline",
       color = "Type") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## JMBayes univariate
```{r}
unq <- unique(crd1_filtered$PID)
trsb <- sample(unq, size = 0.7*length(unq))

trd <- crd1_filtered[crd1_filtered$PID %in% trsb, ]
tsd <- crd1_filtered[!crd1_filtered$PID %in% trsb, ]
crd_fit <- lme(EGFR_CRIC~SEX + RACE_CAT_1+AGE_INTEGER+
                  BMI+HEMOGLOBIN_A1C+HIBP+DAYS_THISVISIT+
                  DIABETES_AT_BASELINE,random = ~1|PID,data=trd) 
crd_survival <- trd[!duplicated(trd$PID),]

rownames(crd_survival)<-NULL
crd_cox<-coxph(Surv(SA_ALLC_TIME_ESRD,event)~as.factor(SEX) + as.factor(RACE_CAT_1)+AGE_INTEGER+
                 BMI+SMOKENOW+HEMOGLOBIN_A1C+HIBP+
                 DIABETES_AT_BASELINE,data=crd_survival,x=TRUE)

summary(crd_cox)

jmtrd <- jointModelBayes(crd_fit,crd_cox,timeVar = "DAYS_THISVISIT",control=list(n.iter=5000))

lt<-c(3,4,5); pw<-c(1,2)

auc_crd<-matrix(0,nrow=6,ncol=6) 

rc<-1;k<-1
for (t in 1:3){
  for (w in 1:2){
    auc_crd[rc,1]<- 1; auc_crd[rc,2]<-lt[t]
    auc_crd[rc,3] <- pw[w]
    auc_res <- tryCatch({
      aucJM(jmtrd, 
            newdata = tsd,
            Tstart = lt[t], 
            Thoriz = lt[t] + pw[w],idVar = "PID")
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Error in aucJM for k=", k, " t=", lt[t], ": ", e$message)
      return(list(auc = NA))
    })
    auc_crd[rc,4] <- ifelse(is.null(auc_res$auc), NA, auc_res$auc)
    lt_data <- subset(tsd, SA_ALLC_TIME_ESRD > lt[t] & DAYS_THISVISIT < lt[t])
    svp <- survfitJM(jmtrd, lt_data,
                     idVar = "PID", survTimes=lt[t]+pw[w],type="SurvProb",
                     M=10,last.time=lt[t])
    prd <- sapply(svp$summaries, function(df) df[,"Mean"])
    
    event_lt <- lt_data[!duplicated(lt_data$PID),"event"]
    time_lt <- lt_data[!duplicated(lt_data$PID),"SA_ALLC_TIME_ESRD"]
    
    auc_crd[rc,6]<-tdROC(1-prd, Y=time_lt$SA_ALLC_TIME_ESRD, delta = event_lt$event, tau = lt[t]+pw[w], span = 0.05,
                              nboot = 0, alpha = 0.05, n.grid = 1000, cut.off = 0.5,type="Epanechnikov")$AUC$value
    
    # auc_crd[rc,5] <- Brier(prd,event = event_lt,
    #                             time = time_lt,event_train = trd$event,
    #                             time_train = trd$SA_ALLC_TIME_ESRD,LT = lt[t],DeltaT = pw[w])
  rc<-rc+1
  }
  
}

auc_crd

```

### Cross Validation
```{r}



# Unique patient IDs
pids <- unique(crd1_filtered$PID)
k <- 5
folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = length(pids)))

cv_results <- list()
crd1_filtered$AGE_INTEGER<-scale(crd1_filtered$AGE_INTEGER)
crd1_filtered$BMI<-scale(crd1_filtered$BMI)
for(i in 2:k){
  
  # Split IDs into train/test
  test_ids <- pids[folds == i]
  train_ids <- pids[folds != i]
  
  # Training longitudinal data
  crd_train_long <- crd1_filtered %>% filter(PID %in% train_ids)
  crd_test_long  <- crd1_filtered %>% filter(PID %in% test_ids)
  
  # Training survival data
  crd_train_surv <- crd_train_long %>% 
    filter(!duplicated(PID))
  
  crd_test_surv <- crd_test_long %>% 
    filter(!duplicated(PID))
  
  # Fit LME on training
  crd_fit_train <- lme(EGFR_CRIC ~ SEX + as.factor(RACE_CAT_1) + AGE_INTEGER +
                         BMI + HEMOGLOBIN_A1C + HIBP + DAYS_THISVISIT +
                         DIABETES_AT_BASELINE,
                       random = ~1|PID, data = crd_train_long)
  
  # Fit Cox on training
  crd_cox_train <- coxph(Surv(SA_ALLC_TIME_ESRD,event) ~
                            as.factor(SEX) + as.factor(RACE_CAT_1) + AGE_INTEGER +
                            BMI + SMOKENOW + HEMOGLOBIN_A1C + HIBP +
                            DIABETES_AT_BASELINE,
                          data = crd_train_surv, x = TRUE)
  
  # Fit joint model on training
  jm_train <- jointModelBayes(crd_fit_train, crd_cox_train,
                              timeVar = "DAYS_THISVISIT",
                              control = list(n.iter = 2000))  
  
  # Predict survival probability at last observed time in test
  pred_surv <- survfitJM(jm_train, newdata = crd_test_long, 
                         idVar = "PID", last.time = max(crd_test_long$DAYS_THISVISIT))
  auc_cv <- matrix(0,nrow=6,ncol=6) 
  
  rc<-1
for (t in 1:3){
  for (w in 1:2){
    auc_cv[rc,1]<- 1; auc_cv[rc,2]<-lt[t]
    auc_cv[rc,3] <- pw[w]
    auc_res <- tryCatch({
      aucJM(jm_train, 
            newdata = crd_test_long,
            Tstart = lt[t], 
            Thoriz = lt[t] + pw[w],idVar = "PID")
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Error in aucJM for k=", k, " t=", lt[t], ": ", e$message)
      return(list(auc = NA))
    })
    auc_cv[rc,4] <- ifelse(is.null(auc_res$auc), NA, auc_res$auc)
    lt_data <- subset(crd_test_long, SA_ALLC_TIME_ESRD > lt[t] & DAYS_THISVISIT < lt[t])
    svp <- survfitJM(jm_train, lt_data,
                     idVar = "PID", survTimes=lt[t]+pw[w],type="SurvProb",
                     M=10,last.time=lt[t])
    prd <- sapply(svp$summaries, function(df) df[,"Mean"])
    
    event_lt <- lt_data[!duplicated(lt_data$PID),"event"]
    time_lt <- lt_data[!duplicated(lt_data$PID),"SA_ALLC_TIME_ESRD"]
    
    auc_cv[rc,6]<-tdROC(1-prd, Y=time_lt$SA_ALLC_TIME_ESRD, delta = event_lt$event, tau = lt[t]+pw[w], span = 0.05,
                              nboot = 0, alpha = 0.05, n.grid = 1000, cut.off = 0.5,type="Epanechnikov")$AUC$value
    
    # auc_crd[rc,5] <- Brier(prd,event = event_lt,
    #                             time = time_lt,event_train = trd$event,
    #                             time_train = trd$SA_ALLC_TIME_ESRD,LT = lt[t],DeltaT = pw[w])
  rc<-rc+1
  }
}
  
  # Store results
  cv_results[[i]] <- list(
    test_ids = test_ids,
    pred_surv = pred_surv,
    auc = auc_cv
  )
  
  cat("Fold", i, "done\n")
}


```
